title: NJCAA Alumni in the 2026 College Football Playoff
content: Several former NJCAA players are making their mark in the College Football Playoff this year. These athletes showcase the incredible talent that comes through junior college programs across the nation.
author: NJCAA Staff

title: Iowa Western's Malachi Marshall named Offensive Player of the Year
content: Malachi Marshall has been named the NJCAA DI Football Offensive Player of the Year after an outstanding season with Iowa Western Community College.
author: NJCAA Staff

title: NJCAA announces DI Football All-America Teams
content: The NJCAA has announced the Division I Football All-America Teams for the 2025 season, recognizing the top performers across all positions.
